Keeper Oren tramped the wet rocks below the tower, lantern swinging, and spotted a bottle wedged in a crevice. Its cork was black with age, the paper inside folded into a tight square. He carried it to his kitchen, warmed the seal by the stove, and drew out a single page. The ink was faded, but the words were clear: a daughter’s goodbye to her father, written fifty years before from a ship that had never reached shore. Oren read it twice, listening to the buoy bell, and understood at last that some lights are meant to guide the living home, while others must answer the dead.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的睡意里。高楼窗中只剩零星灯火，街道被夜雨洗净，路灯拖长微茫的光。出租车无声滑过，把反光带向街角。便利店亮着暖黄，门轴轻响；面馆蒸汽升腾，竹筷碰着白瓷碗，声音空荡温柔。环卫工的橙衣在雾中闪过，扫帚扫过地面，替人们收藏昨夜残梦。天边尚未泛白，城市已在寂静里苏醒。","w03":"- Recursion is when a task asks itself to do a smaller version of the same task.\n- Each smaller version gets easier until it reaches a simple stopping point, like opening one last nested doll.\n- Then the answers pass back up, one piece at a time, until the original task is finished."}
